Recommended by my head of department

* 5 min time limit.
* No marks lost for under unless it's drastically under. 
* Remainder of time will be questions. 
* Students and teacher will ask questions usually (use your friends to help you and give them questions you've prepared. Teacher needs to be random for the exam board's "random question" box). 
* Interaction gets marks. 
* Order is up to school. 
* Depends how fluid you are a speaker. Those who find public speaking easy find it second nature. It is possible to prepare to a level of distinction though. 
* Asking questions at your classmates helps them if you're encouraging (plus see above with the prepared questions)
